lifecycleScripts.afterStart: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=site-plugins composer install --no-interaction --no-progress && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate relevanssi && wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin activate relevanssi && wp-env run cli wp theme activate resource-hub && wp-env run tests-cli wp theme activate resource-hub && for env in cli tests-cli; do if wp-env run $env wp cli has-command 'resource-hub search-index' > /dev/null 2>&1; then wp-env run $env wp resource-hub search-index || exit 1; else echo "Search index not built on $env: the resource-hub plugin is inactive there or its vendor/ is missing. After pnpm composer install, run pnpm wp resource-hub search-index."; fi; done
